verses.text: A song for going up to worship. When I was in trouble, I cried to the LORD, and he answered me.
LORD, save me from lying lips and from tongues that deceive.
What will God do to you, you lying tongue? What more will he do to you?
He will punish you with a warrior's sharp arrows and with burning coals of the broom tree.
How terrible for me that I live as a stranger in Meshech, that I live among the tents of Kedar!
I have lived too long among people who hate peace.
I want peace, but when I speak, they want war.
